'''House Avarhin''' was a noble [[House]] of [[Andor]]. The family was of low standing among the nobility, and had fallen into poverty by the late 10th century of the [[New Era]]. By that time, the only members of the house were Lord [[Willim Avarhin]] and his daughter [[Shiaine Avarhin|Shiaine]].

==Sigil==
The sigil of House Avarhin is the Red Heart and Golden Hand.{{ref/book|9|10}}

==History==
The house came to an end when both Lord Willim and his daughter were murdered by the [[Darkfriend]], [[Mili Skane]].{{ref/book|9|10}} Mili assumed Shiaine's identity and stole the House's wealth, still relatively substantial for a commoner like Mili. 

During the [[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]], she had a house in Caemlyn employing various Darkfriends as servants dressed in Avharin livery. Mili was exposed as a Darkfriend by Queen [[Elayne Trakand]], but managed to escape [[Caemlyn]] and was still at large after [[Tarmon Gai'don]].
